rules.entry: limit at CE, must fill within 12 closed 15m bars after the decision
rules.manage: 50% at T1, stop to exact breakeven, runner to T2 (all at T1 when no T2)
rules.ties: a bar touching stop and target together is a stop
rules.hold: closed at market 32 bars after the fill
rules.halves: IS 2022-24, OOS 2025-26 — nothing here was tuned on either
rules.verdict: POSITIVE/NEGATIVE only when both halves agree in sign AND the day-clustered 95% interval excludes zero; MIXED otherwise; THIN below 30 fills or 15 per half
rules.drift: up = close above the close 28 calendar days earlier, at the decision bar

policy: every filled card with the stop inside 0.5-1.5 ATR, taken as coded
